options.C: metals below hydrogen in the electrochemical series

original_record.ai_explanation: Corrosion occurs in metals below hydrogen in the electrochemical series (like Fe, Cu, Ag) through oxidation; metals above hydrogen (like Mg, Al) form protective oxide layers instead.

original_record.question: Inspite of the electronic configuration, 1s22s2p22, carbon is tetravalent because

options.A: the electrons in both 2s and 2p orbital have equal energy
options.B: the electrons in both 2s and 2p orbital are equivalent
options.D: the six orbital hybridize to four.

original_record.ai_explanation: Carbon's tetravalency arises from sp³ hybridization of its 2s and 2p orbitals, which creates four equivalent hybrid orbitals capable of forming four bonds despite the 1s²2s²2p² configuration.
